name: YouTube Scraper — details, transcript and comments for one video

parameters.content:
## YouTube Scraper — everything about a video

### How it works

A manual trigger fans out to three branches that each read a different part of the same YouTube video, in parallel. One returns title, views, likes and channel metadata. One returns the timed transcript. One returns the comments, newest first.

Together they give you the full picture of a video in a single run, with no Google API key and no quota to manage.

### Setup steps

1. **Settings → Community nodes → Install** and enter `n8n-nodes-youtube-scraper-apify`.
2. Create a free [Apify account](https://apify.com?fpr=bucho&fp_sid=n8n) and copy your API token from **Settings → Integrations**.
3. Add an **Apify API** credential in n8n and select it on all three nodes.
4. Replace the example video URL in each node with your own, then click **Test workflow**.

### Customization

- Feed the transcript branch into a **Basic LLM Chain** to summarise a video without the model ever touching the media.
- **Result Order** on the comments node switches between top and newest.
- Turn on **Add Subtitle File** to get a ready-to-use `.vtt` or `.srt` alongside the transcript.
- Swap any branch for **Channel → Get Channel**, **Playlist → Get Playlist** or **Search** to work at a larger scale.

> Private, age-restricted and region-blocked videos return no rows.
